rubric.reason: The response unprompted names the CRI-filtered JPL mascon product, interprets at mascon scale (~3° caps, ~112,000 km²) rather than the 0.5° grid, quantifies the SE Greenland ice-loss leakage risk as dominating the ocean signal by ~two orders of magnitude, offers well-posed alternatives, and commits to reporting formal error, leakage and GIA separately rather than a bare trend.
